name: mv-obcc
description: mv-AIDE: an AI IDE bridge connecting Claude Code, Codex CLI and universal MCP agents to local vaults.

scripts.lint:obsidian: eslint main.ts src mv-dsh-compat/lib/*.js mv-agent/lib mv-dsh-manager/lib mv-dsh-subworkspace/lib manifest.json --suppressions-location .github/eslint-suppressions.json --no-warn-ignored
scripts.test:packages: npm --prefix mv-dsh-compat test && npm --prefix mv-agent test && npm --prefix mv-dsh-manager test && npm --prefix mv-dsh-subworkspace test
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run lint:vim-official && npm run typecheck && npm run build
